scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: A collection of published librettos from various sources, either published separately or in conjunction with a sound recording.
Issued with RCA recording. Illustrated with set and costume designs from the first production.
Booklet accompanying a Joan Sutherland. Includes aria and song texts. Illustrations from the Sutherland/Bonynge collections.
Issued with RCA recording. Illustrated with costume sketches from the 1896 Bayreuth Festival Ring cycle.
Issued with RCA recording. Limited first edition of 200 copies. Designed by Albert Skira. Includes fine color illustrations of painting with religious themes. 2 copies.
